name: Permanent Residence (General 8-Year Points-Based Category)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being legally and ordinarily resident in the Cayman Islands for a minimum of 8 years (Immigration (Transition) Act, Section 37).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 8 years of legal and ordinary residence in the Cayman Islands.

requirements.blocker_text: A points system prescribed by Cabinet is applied to assess suitability; only applicants attaining 110 points or more are approved (Section 37(2)-(3)). The specific point criteria/weightings were not detailed in the Act text extracted in this pass.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 8 years' legal and ordinary residence
Points-system supporting documentation (criteria not detailed in the source reviewed)

sources.title: Cayman Islands Immigration (Transition) Act (2022 Revision) -- Section 37: general permanent residence category (8 years' residence, 110-point threshold), issuing a Residency and Employment Rights Certificate (RERC)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Cayman Islands' initial build. Grant of this permit produces a 'Residency and Employment Rights Certificate' (RERC), which per Section 37 allows employment with any employer of choice but restricted to occupation(s) specified by the Board/Director -- work_rights is therefore 'restricted' rather than 'full', reflecting that occupational restriction rather than a bar on employment generally. The exact points-system criteria (what earns points, how many, for what) are set by Cabinet regulation, not the Act itself, and were not located at tier-1 in this pass -- flagged as a real gap, not a fabricated pass/fail threshold; only the 110-point bar itself is confirmed. Section 37(11) and 37(16)-(18) provide for dependants, later-born children, and a surviving-spouse's own right to apply -- these are treated as attributes of this certificate rather than separate routes, except for ky_spouse_of_permanent_resident.json, which is modelled separately because Section 37(16) gives the spouse an independently-held certificate application, not merely inclusion as a dependant. switchable_to points to ky_caymanian_status_residence.json since holding this permit is the presumed on-ramp described by Section 28(3)-(4)'s residence-based Caymanian-status grounds.
